name: loop-spiralstream
title: Loop Spiral Stream
description: A helical ribbon of image slots winds toward the camera. 8 image slots, 24s seamless loop, 1:1.
author: Miao Yang

variables.label: Media · Fit
variables.description: Natural keeps each image's own ratio; Crop fills the card box at the media aspect below.

variables.label: Media · Aspect
variables.description: Card aspect used when Fit is Crop.

variables.label: Background · Type
variables.description: Gradient (start → end colours), flat Colour, or your own Image.

variables.label: Background · Gradient start
variables.description: Top colour of the gradient.

variables.label: Background · Gradient end
variables.description: Bottom colour of the gradient.

variables.label: Background · Color
variables.description: Flat colour when Type is Color; also the ground under an Image.

variables.label: Background · Image
variables.description: Cover-fitted background when Type is Image.

variables.label: Background · Blur
variables.description: Blur on the background image, px.

variables.label: Background · Grain
variables.description: Film-grain overlay strength.

variables.label: Background · Opacity
variables.description: Opacity of the whole background layer (0 = transparent ground).

variables.label: Appearance · Media scale
variables.description: Strength of the size change.

variables.label: Appearance · Border radius
variables.description: Card corner radius in px at 1080.

variables.label: Animation · Easing
variables.description: Easing family for stepped motion.

variables.label: Animation · Ease Bezier
variables.description: Cubic-bezier control points for custom easing.

variables.label: Animation · Direction
variables.description: Direction of travel.

variables.label: Animation · Motion
variables.description: Motion (engine parameter; see the block header comment).

variables.label: Template options · Padding
variables.description: Padding (engine parameter; see the block header comment).

variables.label: Template options · Turns
variables.description: Turns (engine parameter; see the block header comment).

variables.label: Template options · Card Count
variables.description: Card Count (engine parameter; see the block header comment).

variables.label: Template options · Pulse
variables.description: Pulse (engine parameter; see the block header comment).

variables.label: Template options · Ring Size
variables.description: Ring Size (engine parameter; see the block header comment).

variables.label: Template options · Taper
variables.description: Taper (engine parameter; see the block header comment).

variables.label: Template options · Card Style
variables.description: Card Style (engine parameter; see the block header comment).

variables.label: Template options · Back Fade
variables.description: Back Fade (engine parameter; see the block header comment).

variables.label: Template options · Perspective
variables.description: Camera focal length: smaller = stronger perspective.

variables.label: Template options · Tilt
variables.description: Tilt (engine parameter; see the block header comment).

variables.label: Template options · Gap
variables.description: Spacing between cards.
